title: Osmotic Properties of Some Aqueous Electrolytes at 60 C (W. T. Humphries, C. F. Kohrt, C. S. Patterson)
experimental_method: Isopiestic method: KCl, KBr and Na2SO4 solutions equilibrated with NaCl reference solutions in a rotating, evacuated desiccator at 59.98 C (ethylene glycol bath), molalities by weighing.
uncertainties_stated: Bath 59.98 +- 0.01 C; over-all average deviation of replicates 0.05 percent; relative sigma' tabulated per run; ratios reproducible within 0.001 in R above 1 molal.
quality_remarks: PDF begins with the end of another article (list of symbols and references on adsorption) on page 1; this paper starts on PDF page 1 lower part. Tables II and III are comparisons with Smith and Robinson (derived). Temperature scale not stated.
not_extracted_tables: Table II (comparison with Smith's KBr R values; derived, literature comparison)
Table III (comparison with Robinson's KCl R values; derived, literature comparison)
